advisories.justification: Published 2026-10-06 with no compatible upstream release: the latest miniflare (5.20261001.0-alpha, required exactly by wrangler 4.147.0 and @cloudflare/vitest-plugin 1.3.6) pins sharp 0.35.4. Miniflare imports sharp only to emulate the Images binding and cf.image resizing; the collector and its test configuration use neither, so no SVG is decoded. Remove when miniflare ships sharp 0.35.5 or later.
